title: Scroll Fix
description: Scroll fix for mouse wheel actions for Linux Wayland
body:
# Scroll Fix

Client-side NeoForge 1.21.1 mod that normalizes mouse-wheel scroll deltas before Minecraft screens and modded UI overlays receive them.

The target is Linux/Wayland setups where GLFW reports wheel deltas that make some UI scroll areas move far faster than vanilla hotbar scrolling.

Should work for x11 as well, just not tested.
